# Stage 2 — normalisation before/after (generated by `src/norm_report.py`)

Val-split S1 entities only. The lexicon and region map were learned on the train split. Name similarity is the rapidfuzz token-set ratio. *before* = basic_key names, *after* = best core/alias-core match (transliterated, legal form and titles removed).
